priorities: Extend the existing HealthBench Professional OpenAI cohort with GPT-6.1 Sol; the seven existing rows are unchanged.
Add HealthAgentBench with model+harness labels and paired cost/time for the original ten-agent paper cohort; two July additions have cost but no verified time.

Add the directly rendered RoboChallenge Table30 V2 physical generalist standings (54 rows): LoopWAM now leads with 43.33% success, ahead of KDDI VLA-DM0.5 at 40.67%. The October 5 announcement placing KDDI first is historical.
Consider DrivingBench as a small physical pilot with one independent chat per system, not evidence of road-driving readiness.
Keep Waymo fleet outcomes separate from simulator and model benchmarks; use October 2 corrected downloads.
